newsitem.title: USA: Salomon Inc Salomon Bros unit Q4 income up.
newsitem.headline: Salomon Inc Salomon Bros unit Q4 income up.

text.p: Salomon Inc said on Tuesday that pre-tax income for its Salomon Brothers unit rose to $296 million in the fourth quarter, compared with $207 million the previous fourth quarter.

Net revenues for equity sales and trading fell to $83 million from $185 million for the unit in the fourth quarter, while fixed income sales and trading net revenues rose to $588 million from $379 a year earlier.

Salomon Inc's Phibro unit posted pre-tax income of $57 million versus $56 million for the fourth quarter and the company's Basis Petroleum unit lost $9 million, compared with a loss of $32 million the year before.

Salomon Inc reported fourth quarter earnings of $1.83 per fully diluted share on total revenues of $2.21 billion, compared with earnings of $1.32 per diluted share on revenues of $2.38 billion the previous fourth quarter.
